name: Vegetation health monitoring from low Earth orbit
briefing: Your team must fly a small Earth-observation spacecraft that images farmland in several spectral bands so analysts can track vegetation health for one year. You need multispectral or hyperspectral imagery at 10 m resolution or better over a swath of at least 15 km, from a sun-synchronous orbit so lighting stays consistent between visits.
notes: Every value under 'parameters' is a scenario requirement or a GAMEPLAY ASSUMPTION chosen for the game. None is a published real-world specification. bus_mass_kg_assumption is null on purpose: the engine then uses each platform's bus_mass_kg from the dataset (an estimate or derived value since equipment_v5). Set it only to override that value for testing. data_generation_kbps is empty on purpose: instrument data rates are not published and none is invented.
